name: Desk Reports
description: Daily and weekly desk reports and breach / stale-feed alerts from trade1, by email and Slack. Paper only.
skill: A service (remote/, deployed to trade1 at ~/desk-reports, service name "reporter") plus a status and settings page. Paper only: the service reads files and sends messages; it sends no order and writes only under ~/desk-reports-data and its own folder. It READS (never writes) Paper Market Maker's ~/paper-mm-data (fills, markouts, snapshots, events), Risk Monitor's ~/risk-monitor-data (state.json, events/<day>.jsonl) and Market Recorder's heartbeat.json, logs/recorder.log and ~/market-data (csv.gz row counts, gaps/<day>.jsonl). Reports: daily and weekly at the times in settings, kept by the service's own clock loop (trade1 has no cron); ~/desk-reports-data/state.json holds last_daily / last_weekly, the outbox (messages waiting or being retried), alerts sent (keyed by Risk Monitor's event id), last_error and hourly free-disk samples; sends/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl is the send log. A report counts nothing after its due time (as_of). Fill rules are never mixed: remote/report.py rule_of() groups fills by their mark (fill_rule or rule; with latency_ms in the label when present); no mark = original rule; reason flatten = stop flattening, kept apart. Markouts use the component markouts (size-weighted bps) and read 'too few' under min_n fills. Alerts follow Risk Monitor's events file and state.json (remote/alerts.py): one raise and one clear per event, a minimum gap per check for flapping. Secrets (Slack webhook, SMTP password) are files in ~/.desk-reports-secrets on trade1 (mode 600), written by main.py over ssh stdin; never in settings, logs, state or the page (which shows set / not set). Stream the page reads: "state" (on change and once a minute: reports.daily|weekly|test {id, day, due, late_s, ch {email, slack: sent|pending|failed|off}, err}, next_daily, next_weekly, alerts, waiting, failing, last_error, secrets {slack_webhook, smtp_password: bool}, settings). Settings (defaults in remote/conf.py DEFAULTS and js/app.js DEFAULTS, keep both the same): daily_time, weekly_day, weekly_time, min_n, email_host, email_port, email_tls, email_user, email_from, email_to, email_reports, email_alerts, slack_reports, slack_alerts, alert_checks, alert_min_gap_s, retry_hours, and test_at (unix seconds of the page's Send a test report now button). The page keeps no kv data. Card line: kit.glance, attention when a send is failing. remote/README.md lists files, the stream and fields.
